programme.title: Men's basketball: World Cup qualifiers: Poland - Austria
programme.desc: In this year's EuroBasket, the White and Reds failed to achieve the ambitious goal of finishing the tournament on the podium. Our basketball players performed slightly worse than three years ago, when they came close to winning the bronze medal. However, they impressed again in the competition with the best teams on the Old Continent. Jordan Loyd made a great introduction to the Polish national team, and Andrzej Pluta showed that he may soon become the new leader of the national team. This gives reasons for optimism before the start of qualifications for the 2027 World Cup in Qatar. Igor Miličić's players will start the fight for a ticket to the World Cup in Gdynia, where they will face Austria - the lowest ranked team in Group F, which also includes the Netherlands and Latvia

programme.title: Women's handball: World Championship - Germany, Netherlands 2025 - 3rd place match: France - Netherlands
programme.desc: The French handball players will not defend their championship title. In the semi-final, the Tricolor team lost to the Germans 23:29. In the bronze medal match they will face the Dutch, who had to accept the superiority of the Norwegians in the previous round.

programme.title: Women's handball: World Championship - Germany, Netherlands 2025 - final match: Germany - Norway
programme.desc: It's time for the final, which will be played in Rotterdam. For the third time in a row, the Norwegians will play for gold. In 2021, they defeated the French. Two years later, the Tricolors took revenge on them. Now their rivals will be the German representatives

programme.title: Football – Match of Legends: Poland – Brazil

programme.title: Football: World Cup qualifying: Poland – Finland

programme.title: Boxing: K&K Ostrzeszów Boxing Night – summary

programme.title: And, Kapitan – Josue | E03
programme.desc: Eight profiles of captains of clubs playing in the PKO Bank Polski Ekstraklasa. These are the top players on their teams. They are at different stages of their careers, have different personalities, life principles and stories, but they are united by their love for football and the desire to win. These are eight great leaders. Josue Pesqueira – the leader of Legia Warsaw in recent seasons and an extraordinary personality. One of the best players in the Ekstraklasa. During his career, he represented twelve clubs. He played, among others, in FC Porto, Galatasaray Istanbul, Sporting Braga and Hapoel Beer Sheva. The Military Captain is a leader who takes responsibility for the team. At the same time, he is a scandalist who often lets go of his brakes. He is loved in Warsaw, the rest of Poland hates him. Poland. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: I was the king – Marcin Robak | S01E06
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Marcin Robak is a two-time top scorer in the Ekstraklasa. He is the last Pole to win this title so far. In total, he scored 120 goals in the top league. Marcin Robak scored 22 goals for Pogoń Szczecin in the 2013/2014 season. He finished the 2016/2017 season in Lech Poznań with 18 goals. He then had to share the crown with Marco Paixao. Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

programme.title: Spies in the snow
programme.desc: The creators of the documentary record funny and dramatic situations involving penguins, polar bears and sea otters. To be able to take a closer look at their heroes, they let spies into their ranks - dummy animals with cameras installed. They go to hard-to-reach, snowy Alaska. The first emissary, an artificial otter, is tasked with filming a mother and her newborn children. Despite the cold, otters can give birth even in the middle of winter. The young are protected by a down blanket. A human eye will accompany the family until the ice melts and the baby takes its first steps in independent life. Some of the material was obtained thanks to a camera placed... in an artificial snowball that moves using invisible elements. It is a true technological marvel, equipped with a self-aligning lens. The artificial bald eagle, on the other hand, uses drone technology. Designed to be indistinguishable from living birds, it allows you to observe nature from above... Great Britain. 2018. documentary film

programme.title: Big Brother Oasis | E03
programme.desc: A nature series devoted to the world's first artificial waterhole and the animals that use it. It was created in a reserve in Tanzania, an area of ​​the African savannah with poor water resources. It is not only an excellent vantage point for hidden cameras, but also a place of respite for wild animals such as lions, baboons, elephants, giraffes and buffalos. Thanks to hidden cameras, scientists want to track the secret behaviors of creatures gathering around the waterhole. They are wondering, among other things: whether half-year changes affect their customs and how predators and their prey coexist on a daily basis. It's raining again on the savannah. Animals using watering holes must prepare for changes. New species of creatures arrive in their areas. Among them are huge herds of migrating wildebeest. They put pressure on the hyenas. Great Britain, USA. 2020. nature series

programme.title: 30 for 30: Requiem for the Big East
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: Auto-SOS, the best. Triumph TR4
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz take on the task of restoring 63-year-old Kel's 1962 Triumph TR4. Kel purchased his beloved British roadster in the 1970s, and it became the car of his youth. He simply couldn't imagine himself without him. Even when the car eventually broke down and had to be garaged, Kel continued to think about it. His plans to restore his pet had to be put on hold after a series of tragedies in Kel's family and an accident that nearly left him blind put an end to all plans to get the car back on the road. Tim and Fuzz "stolen" the car and quickly realized that they were about to take on one of the most complex repairs in the history of the series. Dir.: Stephen Taylor Woodrow, Theo Williams. The owner of the car is Noel, a 50-year-old Celica fan who bought the car with the intention of restoring it and using it as a daily driver. However, after Noel's personal life changed for the better due to a series of spinal injuries, as a result of which he was forced to leave his job and his family broke up, he had to postpone the fulfillment of his dream until better times. Dir.: Stephen Taylor Woodrow, Theo Williams. Led by: Tim Shaw, Fuzz Townshed. USA, UK, 2012, reality show

programme.title: Auto-SOS, the best. Ford A
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz headed to Milton Kane to try to salvage Craig's 1930 Ford Model A. This is a car with a rich history and an impressive pedigree. The owner of the car is 58-year-old former electrician Craig, a fan of classic cars. His Ford Model A served him for more than 30 years, but after a tragic accident on the road, when Craig's whole life changed dramatically, all plans to restore the car had to be forgotten. When the car arrived at the AUTO-SOS workshop, the wooden parts of its body and parts that were 90 years old became a big challenge for the team. Dir.: Stephen Taylor Woodrow, Theo Williams. Led by: Tim Shaw, Fuzz Townshed. USA, UK, 2012, reality show

programme.desc: The documentary takes viewers into the world of the endangered black-backed jackal, which has taken refuge on Namibia's Skeleton Coast. In this harsh and uninhabited region, jackals are forced to adapt to new conditions and learn to interact with each other in order to successfully hunt and obtain food. The film reveals the complex process of their adaptation, hunting and survival in this unique and dangerous corner of the planet.

French-Moroccan journalist Ali Baddou will share his comments and unique perspective on the culture, nature and traditions of this amazing country. Dir.: Yann Arthus-Bertrand. France, 2017

programme.title: d/f Wild Heart of Spain
programme.desc: The Iberian Peninsula is a corner where two continents intersect: Europe and Africa. This is a unique place where nature is full of contrasts and richness, and animals have to fight for survival in the face of sudden changes in landscapes and seasons. We take a journey through Spanish lands to see how animals, from predators to herbivores, adapt to these harsh conditions and survive at the intersection of two worlds. Spain, 2019

programme.title: d/f Menorca. Biosphere Reserve

The status of a biosphere reserve highlights the uniqueness of the island's ecosystem and the diversity of its natural resources, including magnificent beaches, picturesque coves and green hills rich in fauna and flora.

South Korea, 2016

programme.title: Alpenflüsse
programme.desc: Spectacular images of Alpine rivers: They shape habitats, provide for animals and plants - and make people aware of how important water is for life in the mountains. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild Japan – land of a thousand islands
programme.desc:
Japan, with its four main islands and over 6,000 mostly uninhabited islets, stretches over 3,000 kilometers from the Sea of ​​Okhotsk to the Philippine Sea. Flora and fauna fascinate. 

On Honshu, the largest island, there is both urban areas and wilderness. At the temple complex, with the world's largest bronze Buddha statue, in the former capital Nara, wild sika deer are the attraction. The Japanese worship them as messengers of the gods. In addition, every year the impressive cherry tree blossoms in spring attract tourists from all over the world.

Macaques are also increasingly venturing out of the hinterland to find more convenient sources of food. For example, the curious monkeys bathe in hot thermal springs. The spectacle attracts many tourists, who in turn throw small treats into the water for the macaques. Only when the monkeys are full do they retreat into the wild in the evening.

programme.title: Wild Japan – land of a thousand islands
programme.desc: The south of Japan is brimming with harsh natural forces, ocean, volcanoes, typhoons. The remote islands offer a paradise for animals. Incredible symbioses of monkeys and deer can be found here. (Station info).

programme.title: Dogs out of control
programme.desc: Tough task for Graeme: The Akitas Yumi and Yuna attack their fellow dogs and make every walk a torture for their owner Maria. Mixed-breed Pippa, on the other hand, is so hungry that he sometimes bites when someone tampers with his bowl.

programme.title: Veterinarian Dr. Jeff – The Rocky Mountain Doc
programme.desc: This man has been giving everything for animals for almost 30 years: In this special episode, Dr. Jeff, his partner Petra and their practice colleagues look back on the most beautiful and intense moments. (Station info).

programme.title: Veterinarian Dr. Jeff – The Rocky Mountain Doc
programme.desc: Dr. Don has to perform surgery on Gunner the dog. Later, dwarf pony Henry needs treatment for his sore jaw. (Station info).

programme.title: Animal Park: Zoo Stories from Longleat
programme.desc: Koala Burke mated with all three females at the safari park. Can you already see the first signs of pregnancy? A thermal imaging camera could provide the answer. (Station info).

programme.title: Animal Park: Zoo Stories from Longleat
programme.desc: The zookeepers prepare their park residents for winter - and also welcome a range of new arrivals, from fluffy binturongs to adorable dik-diks. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild North Atlantic
programme.desc: Underwater filmmaker Ken O'Sullivan follows in the footsteps of early explorers. He encounters the most diverse and impressive sea creatures in the North Atlantic. (Station info).

programme.title: Big blue wilderness
programme.desc: Cabo Pulmo, a small fishing town on the Gulf of California in Mexico, is best known for its success in bringing the reef back to life, which was almost dead in the mid-1980s due to constant overfishing. \n\nThe same fishermen who previously made their living fishing here are now working to preserve what Jacques Cousteau once called "the aquarium of the world." (Station info).

programme.title: Big blue wilderness
programme.desc: Palau is a small country with a big history. In 2009, the world's first shark sanctuary was established in this island nation in the middle of the western Pacific to protect more than 100 shark species from reckless overfishing and the brutal practice of commercial fishing. The main aim was to stop the cruel practice of simply cutting off the sharks' fins.\n\nIn 2014, Palau set another milestone. The island established the world's largest marine reserve - an area the size of California closed to foreign commercial fishing. (Station info).

programme.title: Haie – mit Steve Backshall
programme.desc: In the Indian Ocean, sharks are threatened by climate change, pollution and overfishing. Steve wants to find out if these perfect predators can adapt to the changes. (Station info).

programme.title: Change of seasons
programme.desc: In autumn, New England's forests become colorful. There is more to the natural spectacle than just the season: moose, beavers, ants and people together shape the natural landscape. (Station info).

programme.title: Change of seasons
programme.desc: After months of darkness and freezing temperatures, Svalbard awakens in spring. Birds, arctic foxes, polar bears, walruses and reindeer populate the lush tundra. (Station info).

programme.title: Change of seasons
programme.desc: The Okavango Delta is hidden in the heart of the Kalahari Desert. The landscape is changed by annual floods, which affect the lives of a wide variety of animals. (Station info).

programme.title: Animals XXS
programme.desc: Being tall has many advantages. But being small also means you need to eat less and can hide better from those who want to eat you. The BBC documentary portrays animal dwarfs such as leaf chameleons, mouse lemurs and hummingbirds, but also comparatively massive tiny creatures such as the pygmy hippopotamus.

programme.title: Animal Park: Zoo Stories from Longleat
programme.desc: Desert fox Anthony has been looking for a partner for some time, but so far without success. Will the little wild dog find happiness with new arrival Zuri or will he have to spend Christmas alone? (Station info).

programme.title: Animal Park: Zoo Stories from Longleat
programme.desc: One of the aardvarks gave birth unnoticed. A nerve-wracking time begins for the animal keepers. Because the little Christmas miracle has to gain weight quickly. (Station info).

programme.title: The wild islands of Ireland
programme.desc: Eoin Warner traveled across the North Atlantic on a 140-year-old sailing ship and explored the fauna on land and in the water. The animal filmmaker appeared, among other things, between basking sharks and experienced the rutting season of the red deer. \n\n2 parts, 2nd part next Tuesday.

programme.title: Wild Britain

programme.title: Italy's wild beauty

programme.desc: Đến Montreal để khám phá Musée des Beaux-Arts. Được hướng dẫn bởi thiền định, Mathias Bensimon tạo ra những bức tranh vẽ sâu sắc và rực rỡ. programme.desc: Tập 5Delpierre và Villeneuve chuẩn bị bảo vệ sửa đổi chống Lymitrol bằng một cuộc phỏng vấn trên đài phát thanh. Bowman quyết định tiết lộ mối liên hệ giữa vợ của nghị sĩ và Quỹ Paoletti. Chloé phát hiện ra rằng cha cô đã gọi cuộc điện thoại cuối cùng trước khi chết. programme.desc: Na Uy: Người hàng xóm Nga đáng lo ngạiĐối mặt với mối đe dọa từ Nga ở biên giới, ở Bắc Cực, Biển Barents và xung quanh quần đảo Svalbard, Na Uy đã tiến hành một cuộc tái vũ trang quy mô lớn. Kể từ khi Ukraine xâm lược, đất nước này, ban đầu là hình mẫu của chủ nghĩa hòa bình và thịnh vượng, đã trở thành nền tảng phòng thủ của châu Âu. Trình bày bởi: Émilie Aubry

programme.desc: Trong khi chuyến đi nước ngoài kết nối thế giới cũ với thế giới mới, thì trên Đảo Oak, cả nhóm rất vui mừng khi có bằng chứng mới cho thấy kẻ ở Lô 5 cũng nằm sâu trong Hố Tiền.

programme.desc: Một người đàn ông có khát vọng viết tiểu thuyết tội phạm đã trở thành ngôi sao trong câu chuyện đột phá của chính mình khi anh ta cố gắng trốn thoát khỏi một trong những trang trại nhà tù lâu đời nhất và khét tiếng nhất Mississippi, Parchman Penitentiary.

programme.title: THE UNXPLAINED WITH WILLIAM SHATNER S3 EP39
programme.desc: Trong suốt lịch sử loài người, các nền văn hóa đa dạng đều sử dụng các nghi lễ thiêng liêng để thể hiện niềm tin tâm linh của mình. Vì vậy, liệu những hành động này có thể kết nối loài người với một bình diện tồn tại cao hơn không?

programme.title: ANCIENT ALIENS S15 EP232
programme.desc: Người ngoài hành tinh cổ đại đang đếm ngược mười địa điểm kim tự tháp hàng đầu thế giới, từ một thung lũng ở Peru với hơn 250 kim tự tháp ẩn giấu đến một thành phố Hy Lạp cổ đại với những tàn tích 4800 năm tuổi cho đến Cao nguyên Giza nổi tiếng của Ai Cập.

programme.title: THE CURSE OF OAK ISLAND S11 EP24
programme.desc: Trong khi chuyến đi đến Châu Âu tiếp tục khám phá những manh mối kết nối các Hiệp sĩ với nền văn hóa Scandinavia và Đảo Oak, thì trên Đảo Oak, manh mối được tìm thấy bên dưới tảng đá Nolan's Cross có thể đưa ra câu trả lời còn thiếu.

programme.title: BỒI THẨM VIÊN SỐ 2 - JUROR
programme.desc: Một bồi thẩm trong một phiên tòa giết người cao cấp phải đối mặt với một tình huống khó xử về đạo đức nghiêm trọng ... một người có thể làm ảnh hưởng đến bồi thẩm đoàn để kết án hoặc giải thoát kẻ giết người bị buộc tội.

programme.title: CHÂN NHỎ - SMALLFOOT
programme.desc: Truyền thuyết về Bigfoot bị đảo lộn khi chàng Yeti trẻ tuổi thông minh tìm thấy thứ mà anh tưởng không tồn tại ở con người.

programme.title: NHỮNG CUỘC PHIÊU LƯU CỦA TINTIN - THE ADVENTURES OF TINTIN
programme.desc: Tintin và bạn bè của anh ấy đi săn kho báu thú vị.

programme.title: CHUYỆN ĐỘI BÓNG Ở SWEET DREAMS - SWEET DREAMS
programme.desc: Bị buộc phải phục hồi, Morris đồng ý huấn luyện một đội bóng mềm nham hiểm phục hồi những người nghiện để chứng minh rằng tất cả mọi người, bất chấp quá khứ của họ, có thể đạt được một cuộc chạy đua về nhà.

programme.title: MINION - MINIONS
programme.desc: Theo chân bộ ba tay sai khi họ dấn thân vào thế giới để tìm một tên trùm độc ác mới cho anh em của họ đi theo.

programme.title: TRẬN ĐẤU PHỤC HẬN - GRUDGE MATCH
programme.desc: Ba mươi năm sau trận tranh đai cuối cùng, hai võ sĩ đã nghỉ hưu và đối thủ lâu năm quyết định bước lên võ đài một lần nữa để giải quyết mối thù cũ.

programme.title: NHỊP ĐIỆU BÁO THÙ - THE RHYTHM SECTION
programme.desc: Khi một người phụ nữ bình thường trên con đường tự hủy diệt phát hiện ra rằng vụ tai nạn máy bay giết chết gia đình cô không phải là một tai nạn, cô bước vào một thế giới đen tối, phức tạp để tìm cách trả thù và tìm kiếm sự cứu chuộc cho chính mình.

programme.title: ANGUS, QUẦN DÂY VÀ NỤ HÔN HOÀN HẢO - ANGUS, THONGS AND PERFECT SNOGGING
programme.desc: Georgia Nicolson, 14 tuổi lập dị nhưng đáng yêu cố gắng vượt qua những thử thách và đau khổ khi trưởng thành.

programme.title: SHREK HẠNH PHÚC MÃI MÃI - SHREK FOREVER AFTER
programme.desc: Shrek bắt đầu làm cho mọi thứ trở nên đúng đắn khi anh ta thấy mình bị mắc kẹt trong một phiên bản xoắn xa, nơi Ogres bị săn lùng và anh ta và Fiona chưa bao giờ gặp nhau.

programme.title: CHIẾC LA BÀN VÀNG - THE GOLDEN COMPASS
programme.desc: Một cô gái phải sử dụng la bàn ma thuật của mình để tìm kiếm những đứa trẻ bị bắt cóc trong một âm mưu có thể gây nguy hiểm cho thế giới.

programme.title: JOKER: ĐIÊN CÓ ĐÔI - JOKER: FOLIE À DEUX
programme.desc: Trong khi đấu tranh với danh tính kép của mình, Arthur Fleck tình cờ gặp được tình yêu đích thực và tìm thấy âm nhạc bên trong mình.

programme.title: KHÔNG NÓI ĐIỀU DỮ - SPEAK NO EVIL
programme.desc: Câu chuyện kể về một gia đình người Mỹ đến thăm một gia đình người Anh mà họ gặp trong kỳ nghỉ.
